bibl.title: Ein Gemmen-Porträt des Ptolemaios X. Alexandros I.
bibl.seg: Erika Zwierlein-Diehl, Ein Gemmen-Porträt des Ptolemaios X. Alexandros I.
Gemmae. An International Journal on Glyptic Studies 1 (2019) pp. 21-34, figg.
bibl.note: The portrait of a Hellenistic ruler wearing the lion-skin on a glass paste in the Martin-von-Wagner-Museum der Universität Würzburg is identified as that of Ptolemy X Alexandros I. This new evidence confirms the identification of the same king on sealings from Edfu, as well as at the first stage of the colossal sculptured portrait in Boston. The portrait on a garnet in private possession may be added.
